primary.title: SIF minimum investment rule: How is the ₹10 lakh threshold calculated for an investor? Experts weigh in
primary.summary: SIFs have a ₹10 lakh minimum investment requirement, but investors need not put the entire amount in one strategy. The threshold is calculated across SIF strategies of the same AMC at the PAN level. Here’s how SIP, SWP, STP, exemptions and breaches work.
